evidence: Offline reranking of all saved candidate pools from the completed full-response likelihood policy.
definition: Mean native base-policy log probability of payload tokens inside complete nonnested tool-call blocks after the first reasoning-close tag, or throughout the output if that tag is absent. Include native payload whitespace; exclude tool wrappers, reasoning, EOS, and synthetic normalization.
conditioning: Action probabilities remain conditioned on each candidate own reasoning and preceding tokens.
fallback: If any candidate lacks a nonempty unambiguous native payload span, execute candidate0 for that whole decision; do not filter the candidate pool. Malformed JSON and unknown tools remain scoreable when the raw span exists.
action_comparison: Equality of the ordered parsed tool-name and argument bundles; six otherwise scoreable pools lacked a comparable parsed action for one of the two selected candidates.
limitations: Saved states come from the original full-response likelihood policy; alternative actions were not executed.
This estimates neither counterfactual success nor new-policy state distribution, cost or performance.

The GUI parser receives the whole response, so the score is defined on the post-reasoning segment rather than universally guaranteed executed-token equivalence. No pre-reasoning tool calls appeared in these saved candidates.
